programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Sounds and Silences
programmes.d: A man's wish to listen to loud noise backfires.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Caesar and Me
programmes.d: A ventriloquist's dummy goads him into committing burglaries.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Jeopardy Room
programmes.d: Major Ivan Kuchenko is trapped inside a hotel room with Commissar Vassiloff, a hitman, and Boris, his assistant, in the room across the street. Vassiloff has planted a bomb in the room and Ivan must find it within three hours or be blown to bits.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Encounter
programmes.d: A World War II veteran and a Japanese-American gardener battle each other over a war that ended more than 20 years ago.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Garrity and the Graves
programmes.d: Jared Garrity arrives in the Old West town of Happiness, Arizona, proclaiming he can revive the dead.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Brain Center at Whipple's
programmes.d: A factory CEO replaces human workers with machines.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Come Wander with Me
programmes.d: A singer's song becomes tragically real.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Obsolete Man
programmes.d: In a future totalitarian society, a librarian is declared obsolete and sentenced to death.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Two
programmes.d: A man and a woman, on opposite sides of a future war, encounter each other in a deserted town.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Arrival
programmes.d: A plane lands safely, but the pilot, crew and all of its passengers are missing!

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Shelter
programmes.d: When a nuclear attack appears imminent, several suburban friends and neighbors fight over control of a single bomb shelter.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Passersby
programmes.d: On the road home from the Civil War, a Confederate soldier stops at a burned-out house and gets to know the owner, a recent widow.

programmes.t: Child's Play
programmes.d: En voodoo-forbandelse overfører den døende seriemorder Charles Lee Rays sjæl til Chucky, en Good Guys-dukke. Den unge Andy får dukken i fødselsdagsgave, og Chucky genoptager snart sin mordbølge. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programmes.t: Mimic
programmes.d: Fra Oscar-instruktøren Guillermo del Toro (THE SHAPE OF WATER) kommer den ultimative kamp mellem menneske og natur. Engang en ingeniørmæssig bedrift, der blev skabt i laboratoriet, har udviklet sig til at efterligne det farligste rovdyr - mennesket.

programmes.t: The Collector
programmes.d: Han er hæmningsløs i sin besættelse af menneskers reaktion på smerte og lemlæstelse, og medierne beretter om, hvordan den maskerede og super-intelligente psykopat holder hele storbyen i sit rædselsgreb

programmes.t: Texas Chainsaw
programmes.d: Gennem mange år var adskillige personer i den lille by Newt i Texas forsvundet sporløst. Befolkningen havde længe mistænkt familien Sawyer, og det lykkedes en ung pige at flygte fra Sawyer-huset efter de brutale drab på hendes fire venner.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Trance
programmes.d: A scam artist purports to channel the spirit of Delos, a former inhabitant of Atlantis. Together with a partner, he makes a living off of it.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Acts of Terror
programmes.d: A woman terrorized by her abusive husband finds some small consolation in a statue of a dog given to her by her sympathetic sister

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Twenty-Twenty Vision
programmes.d: Newly promoted bank loan officer Warren Cribbens cracks his eyeglasses and discovers he can see the future through them. Faced with seeing the future of the farmers whose farms he must foreclose on, Warren can't bring himself to foreclose.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: There Was an Old Woman
programmes.d: A writer of children's books gives a book to a sick young fan. Later, she starts hearing the sound of children in her house.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Trunk
programmes.d: A young man at a motel discovers an empty trunk that grants any wishes. He uses it for popularity, but at a party he discovers who his true friends are.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Appointment on route 17
programmes.d: After finishing a heart transplant, a man finds his personality has changed. He also discovers that he has a strange attraction to a waitress at a road diner.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Cold Equations
programmes.d: A rescue pilot on the frontiers of space is faced with unpleasant prospects when he finds an innocent stowaway on his ship.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Stranger in Possum Meadows
programmes.d: A young boy playing in a field meets an old man who is really an alien collecting specimens to bring back to his planet.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Ring-A-Ding Girl
programmes.d: Bunny receives a ring from her fan club in her home town. In the ring she sees the faces of people from her hometown telling her she's needed there so she returns home.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: You Drive
programmes.d: Driving home one rainy evening, Oliver Pope accidentally hits a boy on a bicycle. Pope flees the scene, determined to hide his guilt, but his car has other ideas.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Long Morrow
programmes.d: Before leaving on his mission, an astronaut meets a woman. They fall in love...

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Self-Improvement of Salvadore Ross
programmes.d: A man finds that he can trade anything he has, including youth and personality, with anybody else.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Number Twelve Looks Just Like You
programmes.d: In a future where everyone must undergo an operation at the age of 19 to make them identical to everyone else, one woman desperately tries to hang onto her own identity.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Black Leather Jackets
programmes.d: Three tough-looking men on motorcycles disrupt a peaceful suburb when they move in. Yet the neighbors could never imagine just how dangerous these men really are.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Night Call
programmes.d: Mysterious phone calls haunt a disabled woman.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: From Agnes - With Love
programmes.d: A computer technician must deal with the queen of all femme fatales: a computer named Agnes who wreaks havoc on his love life.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Spur of the Moment
programmes.d: After being chased on horseback by a terrifying, unidentified figure in black, Anne Henderson faces the biggest decision of her life.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: An Occurrence at Owl Creek Bridge
programmes.d: A Confederate spy is spared death when the rope meant to hang him miraculously breaks. Or does it?

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Queen of the Nile
programmes.d: Columnist Jordan Herrick is startled to learn that a famous movie actress hasn't aged in years. Intrigued, he investigates... and soon learns a terrifying secret.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: What's in the Box
programmes.d: A cheating husband sees his secret revealed and its horrible consequences on his just-repaired TV set.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Masks
programmes.d: A dying man demands his family wear masks that he's given them at a Mardi Gras party.
